# Hermes authority / trust boundary
Semantic pattern: **secure paved road** -> visual type: **architecture** * who may mutate what * verified at HEAD `ac770f7`
UNTRUSTED / EXTERNAL CONTROLLED PLANE Agent (LLM) claims + intent kinds — never raw SQL External provider untrusted content / HTTP responses Intent typed, validated claims (gateway.py) Gateway — privileged gate admission + re-verification + transactional appends Repositories fenced writes — lease-guarded (ADV-02) State (SQLite) append-only event journal; immutable programs permitted permitted permitted permitted content Hazard evaluation evaluate_hazards → HazardVerdict (HZ-02) permitted artifact FORBIDDEN: direct repository call bypassing the gateway stale writes rejected — LockLostError (ADV-02 fence) / IDR29-02 binding guard Solid = permitted ingress * dashed red = forbidden, stops at the control point * meaning never relies on color alone
